name: Vanthorpe Meridian Prestige Chronoband
description:
A wide-profile wrist device in brushed palladium-alloy casing with a sapphire-composite face. The watch displays analog time via physical hands — a deliberate affectation — while a secondary micro-display ring around the bezel shows encrypted calendar, BCI handshake status, and ambient biometric data in pale gold numerics. The band is hand-stitched horween-equivalent synth-leather in deep oxblood.

No logo is visible from the face. The Vanthorpe mark is engraved on the case back, readable only when removed — a signature for those who already know.
functionality: Analog timekeeping with BCI handshake confirmation ring; encrypted calendar sync; biometric ambient monitoring; case-back NFC exec-ID chip for Spire building access; water and pressure resistant to 200m.
what_it_says: Power doesn't need to announce itself — it simply keeps time.
story_hooks: The NFC exec-ID chip in one production batch was cloned from a real Spire access credential — someone inside Vanthorpe sold the mold.
The encrypted calendar on a recovered unit contains appointment logs that implicate a corponation board in a zoning fraud scheme.
A Tier-2 worker is seen wearing one — either stolen, gifted, or evidence of an identity they're trying to leave behind.
related_entities: NeuralPath CivID Plus Identity & Payment BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A substantial, executive-grade wrist chronometer that commands attention through restrained luxury. Wide palladium-alloy case with pronounced bevels catches light deliberately. The sapphire composite face creates depth; analog hands move with deliberate mechanical precision. The secondary micro-display ring glows faintly in pale gold, a whisper of augmentation for those close enough to notice. Deep oxblood synth-leather band suggests old-money restraint.
physical_description.fit: Precise fit on the wrist — not loose, not compression-tight. The wide case sits confidently above the wrist bone without sliding. Band tension adjusted for skin contact without marking. Designed for high-precision biometric readings.
physical_description.primary_material: Brushed palladium-alloy casing with sapphire-composite face and Horween-equivalent synth-leather band
physical_description.texture: Case: satin-brushed with micro-directional grain, cool to touch. Face: smooth, slightly reflective sapphire composite. Band: hand-stitched leather with supple, worn-in tactile quality — slightly waxy finish that develops patina
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte palladium-silver casing with pale gold micro-display numerics. Deep oxblood leather band — rich burgundy with subtle purple undertones. Cream-colored analog hands and markers.
physical_description.closures: Hand-stitched leather band with subtle magnetic clasp hidden beneath the final stitch — no visible hardware
distinctive_features: Analog mechanical hands — deliberate anachronism signaling rejection of pure digital aesthetics
Secondary micro-display ring showing encrypted data in pale gold
Sapphire-composite face with internal depth and slight amber tint
BCI handshake status indicator woven into micro-display
Ambient biometric data readout (heart rate, neuro-state) in encrypted numerics
Vanthorpe maker's mark engraved on case back only — invisible unless removed
Hand-stitched Horween-equivalent band with visible thread
No visible branding on face — pure minimalism
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury — corporate executive, old-money aesthetics, haute couture horology
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by GLMZ corporate elite, neural-augmented professionals, and those who reject flashy chrome. Signals discretion, established wealth, and integration with high-tier BCI networks. Rejects nouveau-riche ostentation.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine condition with developing leather patina on band. Micro-display glows consistently. No scratches or scuffs on casing — protective field or deliberate care.
